title: LAB-DLDH-Annotation-Reproducibility: KJS D330 annotation reproducibility study
description: Code, compact frozen evidence and verified workflows for the KJS D330 annotation reproducibility study intended for Kragujevac Journal of Science. Includes reconstructed filtering, manuscript-specific P1 locus evidence, complete-proteome selected P2 reciprocal searches, targeted HMMER and finite-panel BLASTP comparisons. The exact earliest global BLASTP invocation remains unknown. No candidate enzymatic activity or cohort-wide orthology is asserted. This is an unpublished local preparation; no Zenodo DOI has been assigned.
notes: Related manuscript: KJS D330 annotation reproducibility study (no manuscript DOI supplied). Repository URL is the intended target, not a verified public record.
